import symbols


def test_python_symbols_include_functions_and_class():
    source = """\ndef plain_function():
    pass

async def async_function():
    pass

class Example:
    pass
"""

    assert symbols.symbols(source) == [
        ("def", "plain_function", 2),
        ("def", "async_function", 5),
        ("class", "Example", 8),
    ]


def test_commented_out_def_is_ignored():
    source = """\n# def commented_out():
    pass
"""

    assert symbols.symbols(source) == []
